**Chinese name:** 澜起科技股份有限公司 (Lánqǐ Kējì Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2004 in Shanghai; a global leader in server memory interface chips (DDR5 registering clock drivers), a niche but structurally important part of the data-center supply chain, with an active collaboration with Intel on AI-related chips. H1 2026 revenue reached ¥3.335 billion (+26.7% YoY) with net profit of ¥1.997 billion (+72.3% YoY) — one of the stronger, steadier growth stories among this tracker's design firms, benefiting from the same AI-driven memory/data-center demand cycle lifting several other entries.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Memory interface chips for server DRAM modules and data-center/AI interconnect chips, including CXL-related products.
